activities.activity_name: Aggregated Progress Bar for Composed Jobs
activities.activity_description: Design and implement an aggregated progress bar for jobs that embed multiple jobs within themselves, including UI/backend updates.
Implement support to restart an existing composed job so users can re-launch it at will.
Investigate integration options with the 0.9 release of Kafka to identify areas of improvement.
Explore options to bootstrap and setup Lattice based infrastructure for s-c-d's bare metal deployment.
Implement dot-delimited syntax for resolving properties for Tuple and JSON in stream definitions.
Implement tab completion on the shell to interact with modules and their available options.
Implement and test deployment of s-c-d on Mesos.
Move redis @Rule to a separate repo so test fixtures can be consumed in different projects.
Perform end-to-end integration testing, write unit tests, and update documentation for all implemented features.
